behavior.entry: Reuse the opening screen read button as Refresh trading account and limits; add pull-to-refresh through the same application controller. No read/signature merely from observing a provider.
behavior.monitoring: An already authorized, still valid disconnected monitor reconnects and reaches connected before starting signed snapshots. Failure or twelve-second timeout aborts private reads. A stopped/expired monitor is not silently authorized; existing bounded reads remain possible without claiming live coverage. Pending monitor authorization blocks overlapping wallet prompts.
behavior.account: Sequentially read full current order context with funds (four signatures), then all-account main capacity (up to five signatures). Both must match the current wallet, symbol, account/configuration identity and original context deadline. Nine separate wallet signatures maximum for the complete refresh, no order submission.
behavior.public: Reconnect observed public quotes, refresh multi-asset collateral indices, then wait for valid Mark, selected book/Last and related cross Last receipts from this refresh. A cached still-fresh pre-gesture quote cannot complete it. Snapshot expansion must finish without repeating private reads.
behavior.lifecycle: Read/refresh state disables duplicate actions, percentage selection, review and submission. Cancellation invalidates generation and the active read predicate, releases only the owned read lease, cancels quote wait promptly and discards late results. It does not retract a wallet prompt or cancel an already attempted order.
behavior.ui: Refresh indicator awaits the complete account/capacity/public-pricing operation including handled failures. Existing raw order inputs remain. Loading icon and cancel remain available; safe failure is visible and retryable. Account identity changes clear old input through the existing form behavior.
behavior.validity: Refreshing creates a new signed context and its own original thirty-second lease; public repricing cannot extend it. Events received while reading invalidate those facts rather than being ignored.

verification_scope: New provider/widget tests use production refresh, pricing, capacity, allocation and form code with controlled repositories and public streams. Existing actual signed repository tests remain in full regression. No real private, funds, wallet or address RPC requests.
